card.name: And/to after action verbs
card.fires_on: The linking words "and" or "to" right after an action verb or phrase like "click", "click here", "assess" or "download", where another action verb comes next.

modes.label: Click instructions
modes.description: "to" or "and" after "click" or "click here" in web page prompts, before a verb like view, buy or drag.
modes.example: Click here<< to>> buy your FREE 'Guide to Plant Bre

modes.label: Paired clinical actions
modes.description: "and" after a verb like assess, linking it to a second action such as treat or correct.
modes.example: Before initiating, assess<< and>> correct volume status in patients with renal impairment
